title: Causal bisect -- coarse-to-fine search for where a reference model's behavior localizes in a candidate
description: clozn.analysis.causal_bisect's output: a coarse-to-fine search over clozn.analysis.transplant's controlled-transplant primitive, restricted to COMPOSABLE hook kinds (ffn/head) for any multi-site WINDOW, because residual (l_out) sites overwrite the stream and cannot be combined into a window without one write erasing another (see the module docstring). Both ffn (per-layer) and head (per layer+head) sites compose into windows -- each kind gets its OWN independent tile-and-bisect search (a single window is always one kind; a joint ffn+head window write is not implemented in this slice, see the module docstring). Windows are tiled, tested, and (when retained -- the reference arm beat the random equal-norm control) recursively bisected down to individual sites, which are re-tested with clozn.analysis.transplant.run_site() directly so the stored reference_specific verdict is never recomputed. residual sites (never windowed) and a trivial single (layer, head) request are tested individually when the caller supplies explicit candidate layers. A verdict is a substantive claim only when instrument_sane held for the evidence it rests on; distributed_restoration is reachable ONLY when a composable-kind window search actually ran.

mixed_site.description: One site within a hook='mixed' window_test.sites entry -- the authoritative per-site (hook, layer[, head]) record a mixed window's own 'layers'/'heads' cannot represent (see clozn.analysis.causal_bisect's GAP 2 discussion: 'heads' is positionally parallel to 'layers' only for a PURE head window).

head_site_selection.description: How run_bisect() narrows the head_layers x head_indices grid when it exceeds max_head_sites. ALWAYS present when 'head' was in search_kinds, even when no capping was needed this run (mirrors single_site_seed_derivation's own always-recorded contract). 'stratified_divergence' (the default) allocates the cap across the early/mid/late depth bands the candidate grid actually populates, so a cap cannot silently concentrate every kept site in whichever band diverges most (the coverage artifact measured in docs/research/QUANT_REGRESSION_POPULATION.md's Limits section). 'divergence' is the original, un-stratified, global top-N-by-observational-divergence selection, kept selectable so a caller can reproduce a historical run's exact selection.

screening.description: batched `arms` multi-sequence scoring (engine numerical_regime 'batched_approximate', ~0.19 nats measured drift) is SCREENING ONLY, never a receipt. `used=true` requires every surviving candidate to be re-confirmed with a normal sequential /score call before it appears elsewhere in this document.

composable_kinds_searched.description: Composable kinds for which at least one multi-site WINDOW was actually tested. distributed_restoration in the verdict is unreachable when this is empty -- enforced structurally in clozn.analysis.causal_bisect, not merely by convention.

coverage.description: No silent caps: every bound the search applied (window tiling size, a max-windows cap, which explicit residual/head layers were tested) is named here in plain language, never merely implied by an empty result.

max_head_sites.description: Optional cap on the head_layers x head_indices grid: when the usable grid exceeds this, only the top max_head_sites sites by observational reference-vs-candidate divergence were tiled/bisected -- see bounds_applied for the exact counts.

window_test.description: One multi-site window transplant test (composable kinds only). `retained=true` only when instrument_sane AND beat_control are both true -- the same structural rule clozn.analysis.transplant applies at a single site, generalized to a set of jointly-written sites. hook='mixed' (GAP 2) is a window whose sites span BOTH ffn and head in one joint write -- `sites` is the authoritative per-site record for it; `layers` still names every layer touched (deduplicated) but `heads` is never populated on a mixed entry (see `sites`'s own description).

heads.description: hook=head windows only: the head index for each site, positionally parallel to `layers` (layers[i]/heads[i] together name site i -- a layer may repeat when multiple heads at that layer are in the same window).

sites.description: hook='mixed' windows only (built via run_bisect's mixed_windows parameter): the authoritative per-site (hook, layer[, head]) list this window's joint write was built from. A reader of a mixed entry should use `sites`, not attempt to reconstruct per-site hook from `layers` alone.

single_site_test.description: hook=residual is only ever tested here, never in window_tests (single-site only). ok=true carries the FULL clozn.transplant.v1 document verbatim from clozn.analysis.transplant.run_site() -- reference_specific is read from it, never recomputed.

head.description: hook=head only: which query head this site addresses.

verdict.description: label is the ONLY substantive-claim surface; a document with instrument_sane false for every result it could have rested on must carry 'inconclusive', never a positive or negative substantive label.

primary_metric.description: One of clozn.analysis.restoration_metrics.METRIC_KINDS, named by the caller from the originating case -- never defaulted or picked here.

reference_target_logprob.description: Optional: the reference model's own logprob for target_token_id at readout_position, when the caller supplied one. Enables gap_closed_fraction in movement_metrics; omitted results simply report movement without a reference anchor.

single_site_seed_derivation.description: How run_bisect's caller-supplied top-level seed is deterministically expanded into independent random-control seeds for each transplant.run_site confirmation. The embedded clozn.transplant.v1.random_seed is the actual derived seed used for that site.
